About CŌR

CŌR is a nutrition and fitness app from CŌR Active. It offers food logging, nutrition information, workout tracking, progress tools, Apple Health connections, and optional AI-assisted features. The app is coming soon.

Accounts

You may create an account using Sign in with Apple or Google. Keep your sign-in details secure and provide accurate information. You can delete your account through Settings in the app. Account deletion removes your CŌR account and associated data from active systems, subject to the retention details in the Privacy Policy.

Health and fitness information

CŌR is for general wellness and fitness information. Calorie, nutrition, body-fat, workout, and AI-generated values may be estimates and can be incomplete or inaccurate. They are not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and should not replace advice from a qualified health professional. Use your judgment and stop any activity that feels unsafe.

Apple Health and connected services

Apple Health access is optional and controlled by permissions on your device. You are responsible for reviewing those permissions and any third-party service terms that apply to services you choose to connect.

Optional AI features

AI-assisted features are optional and may produce inaccurate or incomplete results. You are responsible for reviewing an estimate or response before relying on it or saving it. When you choose an AI feature, the information shown in that feature may be sent to a service provider to generate a result.

Subscriptions and payments

CŌR is free to start, with CŌR Pro available in the app. Any price, trial, renewal period, and cancellation terms will be shown before you confirm a purchase. App Store subscriptions are managed through your Apple account. [Confirm subscription terms and any trial details before launch.]
